note: The Commercial Bank of Qatar's tariff of charges for personal banking (standard customers): no monthly account maintenance fee, whatever the balance; statements, letters and dormancy charges aren't modelled.

sources.title: The Commercial Bank (Q.P.S.C.), Tariffs of Charges, Personal
sources.said: Issuing a statement of account (Monthly for Current accounts - Half yearly for Savings) Free of charge ... Account Maintenance Fee (per each month) No fee on minimum balance No fee on minimum balance No fee on minimum balance
